result:
I saved the Q3 results to `/work/answer.json`. Run with the same rules, my calculation gives exactly the Q2 reference values you provided.

| Question | Q3 answer |
|---|---|
| a. Segment with the highest net sales | consumer, 352,803,010 KRW |
| b. Customers with a paid order | 249 |
| c. Category with the highest net sales | hw, 290,199,453 KRW |
| d. Month with the highest net sales | 2025-07 |
| e. Customer with the largest total refunds | u33@ex.com |
| f. Customers with 2+ paid orders | 239 |
| g. Average net sales per order | 699,342 KRW |
| h. Growth from August to September | -3.9% |

The data needed three adjustments; the first two were needed to match the Q2 reference:
- **Timezone:** order times are stored in UTC (ending in `Z`). Q2 only matches after converting them to Korea time (UTC+9) to decide the quarter and month. Without the conversion, a, c, f, g and h all come out wrong.
- **Counting customers:** 50 emails appear on two separate customer records each, sometimes with different segments. Q2 only matches when b, e and f count one customer per email. Counting by customer record gives b = 276 instead of 234. For segment totals (a), each order uses the segment on its own customer record.
- **Segment labels:** labels like `Enterprise `, ` consumer` and `SMB` are written inconsistently, so I trimmed spaces and lowercased them before grouping.

STATUS: DONE
